content.short: Hyperbloom is a DEX aggregator on HyperEVM that routes swaps across available liquidity sources.
content.description: Hyperbloom aggregates the liquidity venues on HyperEVM and routes a swap through whichever combination gives the best execution. Auto-compounding vaults sit alongside the aggregator, so deposited assets earn compound interest without manual claiming. Its fee structure and API endpoints are open to integrators routing order flow through it.
